Both responses are correct (96 km/h), show the same time-based working, and stay well under the 120-word limit. B is slightly better because it shows the harmonic-mean formula explicitly: 2 × 80 × 120 / (80 + 120) = 96. That independently confirms the answer and makes the "not simply 100 km/h" point concrete. A only names the harmonic mean without demonstrating it.
